canonical_vector.format: SVG markup stored as XML for text-only distribution

runtime_raster.policy: render deterministically from the canonical vector; never synthesize

rules.default_for: final MoSo-authored social images and image series
do_not_use_when: the user explicitly requests no signature or watermark
the carrier requires a clean master
a client brand system prohibits secondary marks
the mark would overlap a face, essential text, or narrative evidence
never: regenerate or redraw the signature with an image model
stretch, rotate, outline, shadow, glow, or recolor outside the approved variants
place both color variants on one image
treat the signature as the first-read element
